review_text: They just doubled our subscription price upon annual renewal without any notice. Unbelievable greed. Support will not even reply to my ticket. Email me at carlos.m@growthops.io if anyone is switching.
The email sequence automation templates are pure gold! Saved our sales SDR team 15 hours a week. Very intuitive interface.
Exporting CSV reports is completely broken. It truncates custom fields over 250 characters. I called support at +1 (415) 555-0143 and waited 50 minutes on hold.
Solid CRM core, deals pipeline visualization is clean. The Zapier integration works without hiccups, but the mobile app crashes constantly on iOS.
Canceling our 20 seats next month. They lock your contact database behind a $500 export migration fee. This is predatory vendor lock-in.
Migrated from spreadsheets and our conversion rate jumped 22% in 60 days. The lead scoring algorithm is surprisingly accurate.
Customer support is basically non-existent on weekends. We had a critical webhook failure during a live webinar launch and nobody answered.
Good platform for mid-market teams. Reporting dashboard is snappy. Wish they had better native WhatsApp integration for LATAM leads.
Another stealth price increase! Now they charge per active contact AND per email sent. We are actively looking for an alternative.
The onboarding team was phenomenal. Guided us through data hygiene and pipeline setup. Highest ROI tool in our sales stack.
It is okay, but feels bloated now. Half of the features in the enterprise tier are half-baked. Just focus on making the pipeline fast.
Their mobile app is unusable in the field. Fails to sync offline notes when meeting clients. Reach me at valeria.sales@nordictech.com if you know a better mobile CRM.
Great custom fields capability and role-based permissions. A bit of a learning curve for junior reps, but worth the effort.
Search is painfully slow once you cross 50,000 contacts. Takes 8-10 seconds just to pull up a customer record during live calls.
The automated follow-up reminders have saved at least 5 high-ticket deals this quarter alone. Best investment for our agency.
Hidden contract renewal clause with 90-day cancellation window. If you miss it, you are locked in for another 12 months. Disgraceful business practice.
Clean UI, reliable SMTP delivery rates. Just need them to fix the slow kanban board rendering when dragging deals across stages.
API rate limits are too restrictive for our volume. We hit 429 errors every morning during our automated morning sync.
Our reps actually enjoy logging notes here. The Chrome extension for Gmail saves so much context switching.
Horrible experience trying to downgrade seats. Account manager ghosted us for 3 weeks until the auto-renew deadline passed.
The pipeline analytics and revenue forecasting accuracy gave our board the exact clarity we needed. Exceptional product.
Syncing with Google Calendar creates duplicate meeting events every other week. Support advised me to disconnect and reconnect.
Love the custom reporting builder. Export to PDF is slick, but CSV export lacks calculated fields.
Billing charged our credit card 4111-2222-3333-4444 twice in June and refunds take 30 business days. Beyond frustrated.
Switching our team of 12 from Pipedrive to here was the smoothest migration we have ever done. Email cadence builder is unmatched.
